== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Informant (Japanese)|Informant]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67749 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(19, 37, 433, 613)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>188aa04b29e775805216dc0212bf68f14269717e470bb0eb7b1858a0868a68da</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
